lines: -// Part: frontage (stub: its worker fills in build(g)).
+// Part 5: frontage. The street face of the three houses above the shopfronts: piers on the wall lines, the sandstone
+// string course and cornice, the flats' windows with sills and lintels, the Juliet balcony, the lobby doors, the
+// shop signs (banner letters on the fascia, awning, hanging sign), and a product stand on each shop pier.
+// Everything goes into air only (runParts refuses the rest), so the shopfront clear strip (z 6..7, y 2..4) stays empty.
+import { pier, window_bay, lobby_door, awning, product_panel, shop_name, hanging_shop_sign, juliet_balcony, cornice_run, fascia_board } from "../vocab.mjs";
+// per house: a = low-x wall (window bays are symmetric about a+6), s0 = shop's low-x edge, x0..x1 = the house's width,
+// door = lobby front door, shopPier = the shop/lobby pier that carries the product stand (the lamp posts stand on the
+// other piers at x 13 and 25, so the product goes on the shop/lobby pier)
+// a pedestal of cut sandstone from the kerb up to y 4 under a product, at (x, z 5); only into air
+  for (let y = 2; y <= 4; y++) if (g.isAir(x, y, z)) g.set(x, y, z, CUT_SANDSTONE);
+    // piers on the wall lines: end piers full height, party and shop piers from the bracket at y 5
+    for (const [x, y0] of h.piers) pier(g, x, y0, 17, { bracket: y0 === 5 });
+    // the flats: three windows per storey, glass one cell in (z 8), sills below, lintels above
+    window_bay(g, a + 5, a + 7, 21, 22, 7, 1); // attic: the roof may already fill the gable; skipped cells are reported
+    // the Juliet balcony on the centre French window (skips the pier cells on the shop side)
+    // string course over the fascia and lobby at y 8, main cornice at y 18 with dentils at y 17
+    // the shop: awning, name in banner letters, hanging sign mid-shop, product stand on the shop pier
+      for (let y = 5; y <= 7; y++) g.set(h.shopPier, y, 5, "bookshelf");

input.summary:
parts/frontage.mjs is built: piers on the wall lines, string course y 8, cornice y 18 with dentils, six flat windows with sills and lintels, Juliet balconies, lobby door bays, and per shop an awning, banner name, hanging sign and product stand.
make.sh produced a whole build.nbt; the frontage line shows 696 placed, 0 refused, 0 off-palette. The street render reads three dressed shops (BOOKS, FLORA, TOOLS).
Hanging sign sits at mid-shop (s0+4) rather than on the shop pier, because the product stand takes that pier; the attic gable bay is attempted but unverified against the roof part.

waste.what: Worked out every pier, window, sill, lintel and cornice coordinate per house by hand from plan.md (a+2..a+3, a+5..a+7, a+9..a+10 at each storey, shifted per house).
waste.cost: about 15 window_bay/pier calls typed out by hand, plus a second pass to fix H1/H2 Juliet cells that clash with shop piers at x 33/21
waste.tool: a facade-bays helper, e.g. facadeBays(g, house) that emits the three-storey window grid, sills, lintels and the Juliet balcony from the house's a and s0 with the pier-clash rule built in

waste.what: Checked lamp-post, pier and product clashes at z 5 by reasoning about which x each part owns (lamps at x 1/13/25/37 with lantern at y 5).
waste.cost: three or four rounds of reasoning about z 5 columns before settling product and sign positions
waste.tool: a clear-strip / keep-clear query (mcd sockets check style) for the z 5..7 street row, listing which x,y cells each earlier part already owns

waste.what: Looked at the street by eye for whether a hanging sign and product read; the zoom was too small to confirm the sign.
waste.tool: mcd zoom with --radius 3 on the sign cell, or a per-element census that counts blocks by element name

companions.task: letter the shop names and the hanging sign so the banner letters read at a distance, and check the sign's bracket reads against the pier.
cut the pedestals and the cornice/dentil courses so the sandstone reads as one trim across the three houses.
check the window sills, lintels and the Juliet rail states on the flats, and the attic bay against the roof's gable.

left: Attic gable window (window_bay at a+5..a+7, y 21..22) is attempted but not verified: the roof part fills the gable and its cells may be skipped; check once roofs.mjs lands.
Hanging sign is at mid-shop x s0+4, not on the shop/lobby pier as plan.md's element says: the product stand takes that pier. Plan element 'Hanging sign ... from shop/lobby pier' needs a decision.
Sandstone skeleton's gable coping is the roof's job and is not built here, so that elements.md item stays unticked.

H2 product stand is one potted azalea at y 5 (a single pot, since pots cannot stack), not a multi-row panel; H3 anvil sits on a cut-sandstone pedestal at z 5 y 2..4 because the anvil needs solid below.

`mcd sockets check` reports conducting blocks in the wall lines at y -3, z 8..13, x 5/9/13/17/21 ('rule wall line'). None are frontage cells (mine start at y 1); they come from the shell's ground or the sockets fit-out and need the sockets owner.

`mcd check` floats 36 blocks: smooth_sandstone and glass_pane at y 26..28 (chimney stubs, part 3 not yet built) and stairs at y 25 z 6 (x 6..8, 18..20, 30..32) under the chimney footings; three smooth_stone_slab orphans at z 9 y 6 come from outside frontage.
